notes.claim: In a series RLC circuit the current is greatest at the resonant frequency, where impedance is minimum and X_L equals X_C.
At resonance the voltage across L or C in a series circuit is Q times the applied voltage, which can be dangerously high.

sources.title: Slide 1
sources.quote: Resonance occurs at the frequency, ƒ o, where the current has its maximum value. # To achieve maximum current, the impedance must have a minimum value. This occurs when XL = XC

sources.title: Lessons In Electric Circuits -- Volume II (AC) - Chapter 6
sources.quote: A practical application of “Q” is that voltage across L or C in a series resonant circuit is Q times total applied voltage.

sources.title: Lessons In Electric Circuits -- Volume II (AC) - Chapter 6
sources.quote: A word of caution is in order with series LC resonant circuits: because of the high currents which may be present in a series LC circuit at resonance, it is possible to produce dangerously high voltage drops
